claims.statement: Joe Goss wrote to Cincinnati of his willingness to fight Tom Allen, and a $500 forfeit was put up for Goss at the Empire saloon in the hands of Eph Holland.
claims.excerpt: Goss has written to this city his willingness to fight Allen, and a forfeit of $500 has been putup for him atthe Empire saloon, in the hands of Eph. Holland.

claims.statement: Tom Allen expressed his hope that the fight with Joe Goss would be brought about, and his confidence that he could whip Goss.
claims.excerpt: Allen has expressed his hope that the tight might be brought about, and his implicit faith in his ability to whip Goss.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss to a draw in England about ten years before 1876, the contest stopped by darkness, after Allen had worsted Goss badly.
claims.excerpt: ten years ago, Allen fought Goss to a draw (darkness intervening) and worsted him badly.

fights.excerpt: ten years ago, Allen fought Goss to a draw (darkness intervening) and worsted him badly.
fights.notes: Stopped by darkness. Article says Allen worsted Goss badly; the hint's wording is kept only as the text gives it.

notes: Article is a Cincinnati Commercial item reprinted in the St. Louis Republic.
